name: Price of Knowledge
source:
When Samuell pictured his life after college, it was as an Ancient Civilization researcher paving the way for a brighter future. And he got that--kind of. It turns out being accepting into a group supervised by one of the most prolific researchers wasn't the only surprise waiting for him..

Join him and his coworkers as they discover something larger than they know. There are three characters Samuell can team up with, each having two endings depending on his choices.

[from [url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/price-of-knowledge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当塞缪尔描绘他大学毕业后的生活时，他是一名古代文明研究员，为更光明的未来铺平了道路。他明白了——有点。事实证明，接受加入由一位最多产的研究人员监督的小组并不是等待他的唯一惊喜。

与他和他的同事一起发现比他们所知更大的东西。萨缪尔可以与三个角色合作，每个角色都有两个结局，具体取决于他的选择。

[来自[url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/price-of-knowledge]itch.io[/url]]
